## Using the HSC reference sheet {#dc1-reference-sheet .dc-lesson}

<div class="dc-sheet-row"><figure><img src="../media/reference-base-e.png" alt="Reference sheet: y equals e to the f(x), derivative equals f prime(x) times e to the f(x)"></figure><p>The base-<span data-math="e"></span> rule already includes the chain-rule factor.</p></div>
<div class="dc-sheet-row"><figure><img src="../media/reference-base-a.png" alt="Reference sheet: y equals a to the x, derivative equals ln(a) times a to the x"></figure><p>The general-base rule shows an exponent of <span data-math="x"></span> only.</p></div>
<p class="dc-prompt">For <span data-math="a^{f(x)}"></span>, we still need to apply the chain rule.</p>
<div data-dc-steps class="dc-stepper "><div aria-live="polite"><div class="dc-step" hidden><span data-math="\boxed{\frac{d}{dx}a^{f(x)}={\color{#b55224}f\prime(x)}(\ln a)a^{f(x)}}"></span><p class="dc-step-label">Our extension of the printed formula, for constant <span data-math="a&gt;0"></span>.</p></div></div><div class="dc-step-controls"><button type="button" class="dc-step-back">Hide last step</button><button type="button" class="dc-step-next primary">Reveal next step</button><button type="button" class="dc-step-reset">Reset</button><span class="dc-step-count" aria-live="polite"></span></div></div><p class="dc-sheet-source">NESA · 2027 Mathematics Advanced reference sheet · p. 2 · <a href="https://curriculum.nsw.edu.au/file/65945a13-8dc4-4ebe-97bc-b274a8169734/mathematics-advanced-11-12-2024-reference-sheet.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full reference sheet</a></p>

::: notes
The two images are actual unmodified row extracts from the official sheet, verified on 19 November 2026. The displayed generalisation is our annotation, not text printed on the reference sheet. Derive by y=a^u, u=f(x): dy/du=(ln a)a^u and du/dx=f'(x), so dy/dx=f'(x)(ln a)a^(f(x)). Alternatively rewrite a^(f(x))=e^(f(x)ln a). Make both origins explicit: ln a from the base and f'(x) from the exponent. The chain rule still applies even though the a^x row does not print a composite version. The cropped extracts are embedded for offline use; the full-sheet link requires internet. About three minutes.
:::
